title: phyllanthus ruber
intro: Phyllanthus ruber, commonly known as the red milkwood or red phyllanthus, is a plant species that belongs to the Euphorbiaceae family. It has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, including its ability to aid in the treatment of various health conditions such as fever, diarrhea, and respiratory issues. The health benefits of Phyllanthus ruber include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as reducing pain, fighting infections, and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Phyllanthus ruber include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been shown to exhibit hepatoprotective, anti-cancer, and neuroprotective activities.
